prior_access_exclusion_sources.rule: exclude every source_object_id; Stage E is a subset/reuse of this population
exclude every selected or audit source object; also covered by Stage D exclusion
exclude pilot and formal source objects; also covered by Stage D exclusion
exclude all x1_allowed_audit_samples and every source listed by the ledger
exclude every source_object_id/sample_id; X2-MECH reuses these routes

exclusion_union: normalize source_object_id as dataset_release_id + ':' + release-native object identifier; union all listed sources; duplicates collapse; absence or unparsable source blocks Y2
object_digest: sha256(namespace + NUL + dataset_release_id + NUL + decimal_class_id + NUL + source_object_id + NUL + lowercase_file_sha256)
algorithm: using release metadata only, enumerate classes 0..999 with at least one nonexcluded candidate
sort eligible classes by class_digest ascending then numeric class_id ascending and take the first 100
within each selected class sort candidates by object_digest ascending then source_object_id UTF-8 byte order ascending and take the first one
sort the 100 selected records by object_digest ascending then source_object_id and assign selection_order 0..99
